title: What does it mean?
description:
中文 为 Minecraft 添加全新 UI 界面，优化视觉体验...
English Adds a brand new UI interface to Minecraft, enhancing visual experience...
body:
## ✨ Features 功能
- 全新主菜单界面设计
- 自定义物品栏样式
- 支持资源包适配
- Brand new main menu interface design
- Customizable item bar styles
- Resource pack compatibility
- 
## 🎯 Why use this mod?
- 更美观的视觉体验
- 简洁易用的 UI 布局
- 持续更新中
- More aesthetically pleasing visual experience
- Simple and easy-to-use UI layout
- Continuously updating

## ⚠️ Known Issues 已知问题
- 仅支持单人模式（多人模式未测试）
- 目前仅提供中文语言
- 部分 UI 元素可能存在显示 bug
- Only single-player mode is supported (multiplayer mode not tested)
- Currently, only Chinese language is available
- Some UI elements may have display bugs
